period.rule: A document or posting belongs to the reporting period if and only if period.start <= its timestamp <= period.end, comparing absolute instants (the UTC offset written in each timestamp must be honoured).

fx_rate_date_rule.description: To convert a foreign-currency amount, use the fx.csv rate dated on the company-local calendar date of the document timestamp; if that date has no rate (e.g. weekend), use the latest earlier date. Rows in fx.csv are dated at local midnight.

rounding_rule.unit: minor unit of the target currency

ledger_conventions.currency: Ledger amounts are denominated in the row currency; debits equal credits within every currency.
ledger_conventions.documents: invoices.jsonl holds invoices and credit notes (CN-*, negative total_minor). An invoice dated outside the period without ledger postings is correctly excluded from this period.
ledger_conventions.references: Missing references are null (empty cell in ledger.csv).
